svg.title: Default profile avatar
svg.desc: Drawn in the terminal palette. This file is referenced with an img tag, so it cannot read the CSS custom properties in app/iq.css; #14181B (surface-3) and #4ADE80 (brand) are repeated here by hand and have to move when the palette does. The previous version was an indigo cartoon face from a stock set, the one thing on the signup screen that was not this product's colour.
